text.en: Dog owners highlight Ben's energetic, welcoming, and reassuring teaching style during both private sessions and group classes. Handlers appreciate that he explains canine behavior clearly and puts owners at ease from their very first visit. Reviewers describe his guidance as tailored and practical.

title.en: Engaging training for puppies and dogs

text.en: Handlers observe genuine enthusiasm for dogs of all ages and backgrounds, whether working with first-time puppy owners or experienced handlers. Reviewers note that training sessions keep dogs engaged and motivated through positive exercises, helping pets feel confident throughout their learning.

Clients report lasting progress in everyday canine manners, including calm loose-leash walking, reliable recall responses, and patient waiting behavior. Handlers note that the tools and troubleshooting tips provided during puppy courses continue to show positive results as dogs mature.

q.en: Does Gatsby and Poole offer private one-to-one puppy sessions?
